items.title: Emscripten - mount external folder
items.body:
This PR introduces new storage option for d:
by manually setting Config.storageMode = STORAGE_HOST_FOLDER; in boxedwine-shell-js the user is able to map a local folder on their host to d: in BoxedWine.

The D: drive is an in-memory copy of the host folder. Guest changes are pushed to the host almost immediately after they happen. Host changes are pulled into the guest every 10 seconds, plus on a few browser events.

The change is mostly on the javascript side with some c++ changes to support reloading changed files.
I hopefully ensured the file line endings are not smashed this time...





<!-- This is an auto-generated comment: release notes by coderabbit.ai -->

## Summary by CodeRabbit

* **New Features**
  * Browser users can select a host folder to use as the emulator’s D: drive. Changes can sync between the folder and emulator, with updates detected during use.
  * The selected folder can be remembered for later sessions when browser storage is available.
* **Behavior Changes**
  * With host-folder storage enabled, automatic startup is turned off. Users must select or reconnect the folder before the emulator starts.
* **Documentation**
  * Updated configuration guidance for host-folder storage and its startup behavior.

items.title: introduce a wasm jit
items.body:
A wasm JIT for single-threaded and multi-threaded emscripten builds.
makefile targets: jit and multiThreadedJit. test target: testJit

There are ample opportunities for future improvements
- branch hinting is included, but not actually doing anything useful yet
- profile lead improvements

AOT mode - adding url param jit-record=true will add a button to ui. Clicking said button will create a zip file of generated wasm modules. This can then be run through the script boxedwine-wasm-jit-cache-pipeline.mjs to produce an optimised zip file of wasm modules that can be used alongside other server files in subsequent runs (rename back to app-jit-modules.zip).
ie
flat mode - run binary_en.js to optimise wasm modules
node boxedwine-wasm-jit-cache-pipeline.mjs --flat app-jit-modules.zip app-jit-modules.flat.zip
piped - try to group related wasm modules together and call internal functions directly (better optimisations coming)
node boxedwine-wasm-jit-cache-pipeline.mjs app-jit-modules.zip app-jit-modules.piped.zip

## Summary by CodeRabbit

# Release Notes

* **New Features**
  * Added persistent WASM JIT cache export/import and IndexedDB-backed storage, plus a Save JIT Cache control in the Emscripten shell.
* **Performance**
  * Improved WASM JIT memory access with aligned inline fast paths and enhanced JIT block/persistence behavior.
* **Bug Fixes**
  * Improved cross-block JIT flag handling and dispatch/bridge routing for more consistent execution.
* **Tools & Build**
  * Added WASM JIT cache analysis, pipeline (flat/grouped), and merged-cache verification CLI utilities; introduced dedicated Emscripten build targets.
* **Other**
  * Refined Emscripten scheduler/thread exception handling and improved MIPS title sampling.
